header: How custom detections handle duplicate alerts
content:
An important consideration when creating and reviewing custom detection rules is alert noise
and fatigue. Custom detections group and deduplicate events into a single alert. If a custom
detection fires twice on an event that contains the same entities, custom details, and dynamic
details, it creates only one alert for both of these events. If the detection recognizes that the
events are identical, it logs only one of the events on the created alert and then takes care of
the duplicates, which could occur when the lookback period is longer than the frequency. If the
events are different, the custom detection logs both events on the alert.
